brief: The Founder's Daily Checklist: how I stay focused and sane.

slots.headline: The Founder's Daily Checklist: How I Stay Focused and Sane

slots.title: Own Your Morning
slots.body: Start the day with intention before opening email. I protect my first hour for deep work and a quick walk. It sets the tone for everything that follows.

slots.title: Eat The Frog
slots.body: Tackle your hardest task before lunch when your energy is highest. I schedule one big win before noon to avoid afternoon dread.

slots.title: Batch Your Meetings
slots.body: Context switching destroys momentum. I cluster calls on Tuesdays and Thursdays so Mondays and Wednesdays stay meeting-free zones for building.

slots.title: Set Hard Boundaries
slots.body: Founders burn out by being always on. I set a shutdown ritual at 6 PM and mute Slack after hours to protect recovery.

slots.title: Review Weekly Wins
slots.body: Daily lists feel endless without reflection. Every Friday I write three small victories to stay motivated and adjust priorities.

slots.title: Sleep Is Non-Negotiable
slots.body: Everything breaks when you're exhausted. I aim for seven hours and keep my phone out of reach by 10 PM.

slots.headline: Build Your Focus Checklist Now
slots.body: Steal my template and customize it to your rhythm. Small habits keep founders sane and scaling.
